== Summary ==
Final standings of the 3rd Annual Boonta Eve Jawa Brawl (2022), a GEMP tournament. Bkippel and arebelspy finished first and second and advanced to the Final Confrontation.

* '''Event:''' 3rd Annual Boonta Eve Jawa Brawl (2022); see [[2021 Boonta Eve Jawa Brawl]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2022-08-29
